## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the structural-outline (*kē* 科) for [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's *[Huán yuán guān](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0090)* (T1876), edited by the great Northern-Sòng Huáyán-school revivalist [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán (1011–1088). Like Jìngyuán's other *kē* outlines (cf. [X1418](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0017) for Chéngguān's *Shū*), the work serves as a navigational map for the parent contemplative-doctrinal text.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1067 – 1088) reflects the period of [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán's mature editorial activity at the Huìyīnsì 慧因寺 in Hángzhōu. The *kē* outline is part of the wider Northern-Sòng Huáyán-school project to reconsolidate the Tang corpus through systematic editorial work; the *Huán yuán guān*'s contemplative significance for the school made it a natural object of such editorial attention.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X993) collection.
